urdu.name: حافظہ
urdu.long_meaning: Hafza (حافظہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم محافظ، نگہبان ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

name_story.story: Hafza can be understood through the Arabic form حافظة, whose central sense is protector, guardian, preserver. Hafza corresponds to Arabic حافظة (Ḥāfiẓa) — the feminine active participle of ح ف ظ, 'she who guards, preserves, remembers'. The source gloss 'preserver, memorizer' is defensible in that sense.

faq.a: Hafza is associated with the Arabic form حافظة, whose core sense is protector, guardian, preserver.

faq.q: What is the origin of Hafza?
faq.a: Hafza is associated with Arabic. Hafza corresponds to Arabic حافظة (Ḥāfiẓa) — the feminine active participle of ح ف ظ, 'she who guards, preserves, remembers'. The source gloss 'preserver, memorizer' is defensible in that sense.
Yes — the underlying form حافظة is Arabic.
Hafza can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hafza should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. True

faq.q: What does Hafza mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Hafza is rendered حافظہ and carries the sense محافظ، نگہبان.

faq.q: What does Hafza mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hafza is rendered حافظه and carries the sense نگهبان، نگاه‌دارنده.
A romanized syllable approximation is haf-za. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hafza?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hafza, hafza. Script forms are حافظة, حافظه, حافظہ, हाफ़िज़ा.

faq.q: Is Hafza a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
